headline: Domingo Cedeno's walk-off homer beats Arizona in 11th
recap: Domingo Cedeno hit a two-run home run off Bobby Chouinard with one out in the bottom of the 11th inning, scoring Kevin Sefcik and giving the Phillies a 4-2 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks at Veterans Stadium.

Randy Johnson started for Arizona and struck out 10 over eight innings, allowing two runs. Randy Wolf matched him for Philadelphia, going 7.1 innings with seven strikeouts. Each starter was undone by a two-run homer: Greg Colbrunn's put Arizona ahead in the fourth, and Ron Gant answered with a two-run shot of his own off Johnson in the eighth to tie it.
Arizona put the go-ahead run at third base in the top of the 11th, but Scott Rolen started a force play to end the threat. Wayne Gomes, who worked the 10th and 11th, picked up the win.
